contents.text: Getting cold down here! Added more ways to boost your body temperature through movement
Increased nutrition value of Cured Sand
Added Prismaridian Armour as an upgrade to diamond, which keeps you hydrated in the Nether (like Prismarine) but also offers diamond-level protection. Note: It's not fireproof!
Added a few custom enchantments, all available in the Enchanting Table for now. Note that Silk Touch has been nerfed for Bee Nests and Ice. Snowballs are obtainable through clay
Modified some other vanilla enchantments, maybe more to follow

Fixed Bugs:
Prismarice may only be eaten when hungry
